links.outcome: Physical therapist Likert ratings of accuracy, completeness and redundancy, plus Flesch Reading Ease readability of LBP patient education materials
links.effect: RAG-based LLMs rated more accurate, more complete, more readable and less redundant than traditional LLMs; no numeric values given in the abstract
links.tradeoff: Generated materials were still judged not ready for clinical practice; significant challenges remain in clinical relevance and granularity of content.
links.quote: The findings demonstrate that RAG-based LLMs outperform traditional LLMs, providing more accurate, complete, and readable patient education materials with less redundancy.
